def finite_json(value,path="$",missing=None):
 if missing is None:missing=[]
 if isinstance(value,float) and not math.isfinite(value):
  missing.append({"path":path,"original_value":repr(value)})
  return None
 if isinstance(value,dict):return {k:finite_json(v,path+"."+str(k),missing) for k,v in value.items()}
 if isinstance(value,(list,tuple)):return [finite_json(v,path+"["+str(i)+"]",missing) for i,v in enumerate(value)]
 return value
